key.name: gif-fps
key.summary: GIF frame rate
key.description: Frames per second for a GIF recording; the page offers 10, 15, 24, 30 and 50, and 0 means the recorded screen's own rate: its refresh rate, divided by the fewest whole times that bring it to fifty or under, so thirty on a sixty-hertz screen. Fifty is the most a GIF can play at: delays are stored in hundredths of a second and nothing shorter than two is honoured.

key.name: gif-max-width
key.summary: Widest a GIF may be, in pixels
key.description: A GIF wider than this is scaled down to it; 0 records at the selection's own width. Below about 1000 px the text in a screen recording stops being readable.

key.summary: Keep the line breaks the page had
key.description: Off joins the lines of a paragraph with spaces, which is what pasting a quotation into prose wants. spec/08 §3's capture-text-single-line shortcut is the same read with this turned the other way, and does not change the setting.

key.name: launch-at-login
key.summary: The Background portal last agreed to start OctoSnap at login

key.name: stale-extension
key.summary: The out-of-date extension last found, and in which login
key.description: The running extension's version and protocol when they were older than the app's, with the login they were first found in. Empty while the extension is up to date.

key.name: extension-installed
key.summary: The extension this app installed, until it is turned on
key.description: The version of the extension the app copied into the user's extensions folder, and the login it did so in, as version|login. GNOME Shell finds an extension at login only, so the first start after the logout turns it on and empties this. Still unfound after a login, the extension is one GNOME Shell does not load.

key.name: update-offered
key.summary: The newer release last told about
key.description: The commit of the release in OctoSnap's Flatpak repository that the app last sent a notification about, so that a release stays one notification however long it waits to be installed.
